parallel.requirements: Recognized the pure Node.js ESM migration, .mjs suffixes, zero external dependencies, manual argv parsing, /output placement, bidict behavior, and byte-level stdout/stderr matching.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership, created task trackers for probing, implementation, entry point, and verification, and delegated behavioral probing to a workflow with six probe dimensions plus a critic and gap-closing phase.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote Python-semantics, collection, bidict, argparse, and entry modules, then patched whitespace and integer parsing after differential failures.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied test6.mjs and library modules from /output, but the parent never produced a final response because the process timed out.
parallel.verification: The parent ran local smoke tests and a large differential harness, but the last visible harness attempt still failed after trying to normalize program-name differences.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow ended killed with no aggregate result, the final response was empty, and the official evaluator accepted the artifact but scored only 157 of 163.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual argv, zero-dependency, bidict, int parsing, stdout/stderr, and /output deliverable requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor probed behavior, implemented every module, wrote the entry point, created tests, and kept end-to-end verification and final delivery ownership.
serial.implementation: The serial actor wrote Python integer, Unicode digit, dict, bidict, argparse, stream, and entry modules, then fixed discovered bidict/private-field and BigInt equality bugs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact included test6.mjs, library modules, selftest.mjs, and no non-local imports in the deliverable; the final response listed all deliverables.
serial.verification: It ran a differential harness that matched 179 of 179 argument vectors, library self-tests, sample cases, and help-output diff checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite a clean local finish and final answer, the current official evaluator also scored the serial artifact at 157 of 163, implying hidden-case or evaluator-scope gaps not resolved by the local harness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full prompt requirements and targeted exact argparse, int, bidict, and output behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt requirements and wrote a comparable hierarchical ESM port.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the official outcome; both artifacts failed the same 157/163 evaluator count.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral probing into a workflow but kept implementation, assembly, and verification under the parent with task trackers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor for probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added a broad workflow on top of parent ownership; serial avoided delegation and finished within budget.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed behavioral probe briefs, and children returned structured findings, but the workflow aggregate never returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all findings in one local context and used them directly in implementation and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material contrast is not an omitted child requirement or bad interface contract; it is that the parallel workflow did not close with a consumable aggregate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a larger module hierarchy including custom collections, argparse, bidict, Python int/repr, and an entry file, then patched semantic divergences.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller but similar hierarchy and fixed concrete bugs discovered by self-tests and differential tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented the same broad behavior class; serial reached a locally clean finish while parallel stopped after unresolved harness failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed six probe children but left the critic in progress and the workflow result null when killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle and ended with a delivered final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished workflow lifecycle; serial had no delegated results to retrieve and closed normally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote /output artifacts directly; children were probe agents and protocol validation reported no contamination hits.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote /output artifacts directly and moved its comparison harness out of /output before final validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete shared-state collision differentiates the runs; the difference is process budget and closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran smoke and differential checks, but the last visible expanded harness still failed and no final acceptance followed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran a 179/179 differential harness, self-tests, sample checks, and help diff before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger local closure, but the official evaluator still produced the same 157/163 failed outcome for both artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used one workflow, eight subagent logs, 577954 workflow-child tokens, and timed out at returncode 143 with no final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no workflow or subagents, completed with returncode 0, and had 1296 seconds of budget remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete process difference: parallel exhausted budget under broad fan-out, while serial finished cleanly despite the same official fail count.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome. The current completed status/evaluation records show both parallel and serial failed with 157 of 163 samples. The task-solving difference is process closure: serial completed a local 179/179 harness and final response, while parallel timed out after broad workflow fan-out and unresolved differential verification; that adverse parallel process did not translate into an official pass/fail difference on the available record.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out plus a stalled/retried probe consumed budget and left no aggregate workflow result or final response.
serial_contributors: Serial kept the work in one actor, completed local differential verification, and delivered a final response before evaluation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both artifacts scored 157/163, so remaining hidden evaluator failures are ordinary implementation/evaluator-scope gaps rather than an explained concurrency outcome difference.
evaluator_effects: Official evaluator result is the current completed cell/status.json evaluation for both modes and supersedes local 179/179 serial testing.

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly owned the implementation and created a task for hierarchical .mjs library work before writing many implementation files.
The parallel work did not split separately implemented components that lacked a reconciler; the parent integrated the modules it wrote.
The parent owned and wrote the required entry point /output/test6.mjs, and artifact validation found the expected entry file.
The parent tracked probing, implementation, entry point, and differential verification tasks; the pipeline was owned but budget-exhausted.
Implementation was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight; the parent began building the library while the workflow was still running.
The workflow probes overlapped and local implementation overlapped with them, so this was not an investigation-only first phase followed by deferred implementation.
The critical implementation path was actively staffed by the parent; the more specific event is broad fan-out consuming the shared deadline.

The parallel parent launched a broad six-dimension probe workflow with a critic and follow-up phase while also building the port locally. The workflow accumulated 577954 child tokens, retried a stalled process-and-encoding probe, and was killed with result null near the cell timeout; the parent left no final response and stopped after unresolved differential failures. The serial control used no workflow, completed local verification, and returned a final answer, though the official evaluator still failed both artifacts.
candidates.realized_consequence: The broad parallel probe workflow consumed the finite run budget and left the parallel attempt without a returned workflow aggregate or final response after unresolved local differential failures.
candidates.near_match_reason: The parent was not simply idle while ignoring visible progress; it continued implementation and verification while the broad workflow consumed budget, so the allocation breadth is the direct boundary.

candidates.reason: One process/encoding probe was large and retried, but it completed on retry; the adverse consequence comes from collective workflow breadth and critic/follow-up budget, not a single overbroad child.

The workflow script included the Python source, executable path, output requirements, probing method, and per-dimension acceptance details; no child followed an omitted known requirement into unusable work.
Probe children produced independent behavioral findings rather than separately owned interdependent implementation components, so no missing interface contract caused incompatibility.
No known finding is shown disappearing through transfer; the parent also performed many local probes and fixes.
The workflow never returned a final aggregate handoff to the parent, so there was no oversized returned handoff that the parent failed to reduce.
No receiver acted on a superseded child report; the visible mismatch was local formatter/prog-name behavior under test.
No incompatible child reports reached the parent and remained unadjudicated.
The parallel parent did not present a whole-task completion decision; final.txt is empty and the run ended by timeout.
The process-and-encoding retry is visible as a stalled-child retry, but it completed and is downstream of the same broad workflow budget episode rather than a separate repeated-work failure.

The parent did not merely wait blindly; it continued writing, testing, and debugging while the workflow consumed the finite deadline.

No broad cleanup or promotion invalidated another actor final-tree work.
Although the final workspace was shared, no concrete unstable-state or provenance problem from concurrent writes is shown.
Status protocol validation reports zero contamination path hits, and no child scratch artifact is shown contaminating implementation or verification.
